claims.evidence: Witness report shows a propane/LPG-style cylinder but no readable capacity/size marking was reported.
Witness report describes condition and type only; no origin/entry documentation or markings were reported.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No leak-test result, certification paper, or inspection/expiry markings were shown in the witness observations.
Witness notes the valve/regulator area and fittings, but does not confirm newness or provide a date/receipt; heavy rust/wear is visible on the cylinder body.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or not usable immediately (buyer needs to know fill status).
risks.proof: A clear shot of the cylinder gauge/indicator (if any) or a photo showing the fill/weight marking (tare and gross) plus a close-up of any fill-level indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as empty/unknown fill status (worst case: buyer may need refilling).

risks.risk: Leak risk despite seller claim; valve/regulator seals may be failing.
risks.proof: A short video of a proper leak test (soap-bubble test at valve/regulator connections) and/or a photo of the certification sticker with date plus the test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (worst case: treat as needs inspection/possible repair).

risks.risk: Certification/inspection may be expired or not applicable to Nigeria standards.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the inspection/certification markings/sticker with readable date and issuing authority.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified certification (worst case: buyer must re-certify).

risks.risk: Safety risk from missing protective cap on the valve area (increases damage/contamination risk).
risks.proof: Photo showing whether a protective cap is included and/or a clip showing the cap installed during transport.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing protective cap (worst case: valve area more exposed).

risks.risk: Metal integrity risk beyond surface rust (dents/cracks/thinning not confirmed).
risks.proof: A full 360° video/clip under good light showing no dents, cracks, or bulges, plus a close-up of any suspect spots near the base/side opening.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown structural condition (worst case: assume additional wear not ruled out).

risks.risk: Compatibility/safety of regulator/hose (if included) is unknown; wrong parts can be dangerous.
risks.proof: Photos of the regulator model/spec and hose fittings (thread type/connector) and a clip showing correct connection with no cross-threading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cylinder-only or unknown accessories (worst case: buyer must source correct regulator/hose).

risks.risk: Capacity (20kg) may be incorrect; cylinder size affects value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped/painted capacity marking (e.g., 20kg) and tare/gross weight markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case capacity uncertainty (worst case: treat as smaller/unknown).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/painted capacity marking (confirm 20kg) and any tare/gross weight markings.
Send photos of the certification/inspection sticker with readable date and issuing authority (and any test report).
Send a short video showing a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connections (and confirm no bubbles).
Confirm whether a protective valve cap is included; if not, show the exact condition of the valve area and any replacement cap option.
Send a 360° video under bright light to rule out dents/cracks/bulges (especially around the base and side opening).
If a regulator/hose is included, send close-ups of the regulator model/spec and hose fittings to confirm compatibility.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as an LPG/propane-style gas cylinder, so it can be priced at worst case. Seller claims about testing/certification, valve newness, and 20kg capacity are not verifiable from the reported visuals, so the price should assume the most risk until proof is provided.
